{{URL|instyle.com}} (US) | issn = 1076-0830 }} '''''InStyle''''' is an American monthly women's [[fashion magazine]] founded in 1994.{{cite news|first= Matthew|last= Rose|title='Real Simple' Magazine was Anything but for Time Inc.|url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB960332052872538095|access-date=December 12, 2015|work=The Wall Street Journal|date=June 7, 2000}} It is owned by [[People Inc.]], and started originally as a [[brand extension]] of ''[[People (magazine)|People]]'' before carving out its own identity.{{cite web |url= http://www.magazine-agent.com/instyle/magazine|title=InStyle Magazine|work=Magazine Agent|access-date=March 21, 2012}} In February 2022, it was announced that ''InStyle'' would cease print publications and move to a digital-only format.{{Cite news |date=February 9, 2022 |title=Entertainment Weekly, InStyle and four other Meredith magazines will cease print publications |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2022-02-09/iac-will-cease-printing-entertainment-weekly-and-other-meredith-magazines}} ==Description== The magazines content included beauty, fashion, home, entertaining, philanthropy, celebrity lifestyles, feminism, and human-interest stories. In 2018, ''InStyle'' became the first major fashion magazine to ban photography of and advertisements featuring fur. The ban on fur intended to showcase the animal cruelty necessary to produce fur garments, and to encourage others to refrain from fur consumption. The organization [[PETA]] was supportive of the editorial change. Dotdash Meredith, the media group that acquired InStyle in 2021, announced that they would be terminating the publication's print issues. InStyle's final print publication was the April 2022 issue. InStyle subsequently became digital-only. Neil Vogel, CEO of Dotdash Meredith, stated that the magazine would move to an all digital format because "print is no longer serving the brand's core purpose."{{Cite web |last=McCall |first=Tyler |title='InStyle' to End Print, Going Digital-Only [UPDATED] |url=https://fashionista.com/2022/02/instyle-print-magazine-ending-digital-only |access-date=2023-04-21 |website=Fashionista |language=en}} == Editors == {| class="wikitable" |+Editors of InStyle !Country !Circulation dates !Editors !Start year !End year !{{Refh}} |- | rowspan="5" |United States (''InStyle'') | rowspan="5" |1994–2022 |Martha Nelson |1993 |2002 |{{Cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=2015-10-25 |title=Yahoo Puts Martha Nelson, Former Time Inc.
